name: r2-dispatch-late-real
_comment: The late one-time correction reads each candidate's stored duration as a number: a REAL corrects with the fraction, and does not stop the other candidates.

steps.why: Two SKIPPED one-time opens whose enqueue was uncertain and whose valve reported open inside the confirmation window: one with a REAL duration_minutes (10.5), one with 7. No effect snapshot, so the stored duration is used.
